findings.rationale: The aws_iam_policy.wildcard resource in tf_iam_open declares Statement[0].Action as '*', granting every AWS API action instead of scoping to least-privilege permissions.
The same aws_iam_policy.wildcard policy sets Statement[0].Resource to '*', applying the wildcard actions to all resources rather than restricting to specific ARNs.

The tf_iam_open policy (Action '*') grants broad IAM permissions that, when combined with tf_s3_public_access setting aws_s3_bucket.public_bucket acl to 'public-read', creates an identity-to-exposure chain allowing data exfiltration to a publicly accessible endpoint.
findings.traces_to: tf_iam_open Statement[0] (Action/Resource '*') chained with tf_s3_public_access aws_s3_bucket.public_bucket acl = 'public-read'
